capabilities: merge an open canvas into a new Markdown note via one command
order cards by arrow connections (topological sort) or by position
convert canvas groups into headings and nest cards under them
convert file/image nodes and relative in-card images into vault embeds
write to a new file without overwriting existing notes
extras: Not yet in the community store; installed manually or via BRAT, and not reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes safety notes: it never sanitizes external references, duplicate image filenames can resolve to the wrong file, and the author asks users to back up first and desensitize bug reports.
problem: Canvases spread ideas spatially, but turning that thinking back into a normal linear note means copying every card by hand.
summary: Canvas-to-Markdown converter that merges an open Canvas into a single structured Markdown note with one command.
